Petition of Massachusetts Electric Company and Nantucket Electric Company, each d/b/a National Grid, for recovery of incremental operations and maintenance expenses associated with eight (8) qualifying storm events that occurred from January through December 2022: (1) Motion for Exception from Department Practice related to the provision of voluminous invoices and/or supporting documentation in Exhibits “G-1” and Exhibits “L” for Exhibits NG-4 through NG-11 for each storm and Exhibit NG-3-C via a file sharing website; (2) Motion for Protective Order related to the confidential material included with the back-up documentation contained in Exhibits “G-1” and Exhibits “L” for Exhibits NG-4 through NG-11 for each storm and Exhibit NG-3-C; (3) Witness Affidavits of Kathleen M. Hammer, Dennis McNamara and Timothy C. Moore, (4) Appearances of Counsel for Bonnie Raffetto and Houghton. Due to size, many exhibits are not posted here but may be obtained from the Department upon request.
